[short] skip

# Install an echo command because Windows doesn't have it.
env BOLERO_BIN=$WORK/tmp/bin
bolero install echo.go
env PATH=$BOLERO_BIN${:}$PATH

# Test bolero generate handles a simple command
bolero generate ./generate/simple.go
stdout 'Success'

# Test bolero generate handles a command alias
bolero generate './generate/alias.go'
stdout 'Now is the time for all good men'

# Test bolero generate's variable substitution
bolero generate './generate/substitution.go'
stdout $GOARCH' substitution.go:7 pabc xyzp/substitution.go/123'

# Test bolero generate's run and skip flags
bolero generate -run y.s './generate/flag.go'
stdout 'yes' # flag.go should select yes
! stdout 'no' # flag.go should not select no

bolero generate -skip th..sand './generate/flag.go'
stdout 'yes' # flag.go should select yes
! stdout 'no' # flag.go should not select no

bolero generate -run . -skip th..sand './generate/flag.go'
stdout 'yes' # flag.go should select yes
! stdout 'no' # flag.go should not select no

# Test bolero generate provides the right "$GOPACKAGE" name in an x_test
bolero generate './generate/env_test.go'
stdout 'main_test'

# Test bolero generate provides the right "$PWD"
bolero generate './generate/env_pwd.go'
stdout $WORK'[/\\]gopath[/\\]src[/\\]generate'

-- echo.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(strings.Join(os.Args[1:], " "))
	fmt.Println()
}
-- generate/simple.go --

// +build ignore

//go:generate echo Success

//go:generate echo no, no, a thousand times no

package p

//go:generate echo $GOPACKAGE
